explanation: An in-context repetition (induction) detector: it fires on tokens that re-enact a token sequence already present earlier in the same context. The peak falls on the first or a middle subword of a repeated rare multi-piece word (second mention of Bodewryd, Telgemeier, CBDB, Xylotrex, a username) at about 0.4-0.6 of max. Tokens inside a repeated common phrase, list, code block or chat-log line reach about 0.25-0.4, and activity spreads and grows over long documents whose material keeps recurring. Text whose words and phrases have not appeared before in the context stays below about 0.2 of max. The one known exception is a split sentence-initial stance adverb such as Hon|estly or Frank|ly, which reaches about 0.4-0.5 without any repetition.
